sections.title: 1. Introduction & Module Overview
sections.intro:
POS (Point of Sale) module hotel ke saare F&B outlets ka complete billing system hai — Restaurant, Bar, Room Service aur speciality outlets (jaise TADKA).

Analysis HMS me POS ka workflow hai: Guest order deta hai → Captain/Waiter KOT banata hai (Kitchen Order Ticket) → Kitchen item banata hai → Bill generate hota hai → Settlement (Cash/UPI/Card/Room) hota hai. Room settlement me bill direct guest ke folio me post ho jata hai.

POS OUTLETS (demo me):
RES = Restaurant | RS = Room Service | BA = Bar | TAD = TADKA (speciality). Har outlet ka apna menu, tables, rates aur settings hote hain — par system same hai.

rows: KOT Entry, Sale Bill Entry (har outlet ka)
Settlement, Table Change/Booking, KOT Transfer, Display Table, Bill Lockup, Payment Received, Service Desk

sections.title: 3. Outlet Screens — KOT & Sale Bill
sections.intro: Har outlet (Restaurant/Bar/Room Service/TADKA) ke liye same screens hain — bas outlet code alag. Restaurant (RES) example se samjho.

subsections.title: 3.1 KOT Entry (Kitchen Order Ticket) — Sabse Zyada Use Hone Wali Screen
subsections.navPath: Point Of Sale ▶ Restaurant ▶ Kot Entry
subsections.paragraph: Guest ka order yahin se kitchen jata hai. Table select karo → items pick karo → qty set → Save KOT. KOT print hota hai aur kitchen order shuru kar deta hai. Bill baad me banta hai.

rows: Kaunsa outlet, current time, KOT number
Kaunsi table ka order (Room Service me Room No.)
Kaunsa staff order le raha hai
KOT save + print — kitchen ko jata hai
Galat KOT cancel karo (log me record hota hai)

subsections.title: 3.2 Sale Bill Entry — Bill banana
subsections.navPath: Point Of Sale ▶ Restaurant ▶ Sale Bill Entry
subsections.caption: Sale Bill Entry — Restaurant outlet (RES)
subsections.paragraph: KOT ke items bill me convert karo: Table/Bill No. load karo → items verify karo → discount agar ho → Bill Print ya Room Charge (guest folio me post).

rows: Room No. / Guest Name / Bar Code se bill dhundo
KOT se aaye items — qty, rate, amount edit (authorized)
Discount, Service Charge, CGST, SGST, Round Off, Net
In-house guest ka bill folio me post karo

subsections.title: 3.2b Room Service Sale Bill (RS)
subsections.navPath: Point Of Sale ▶ Room Service ▶ Sale Bill Entry
subsections.paragraph: Room Service ka bill direct guest ke room folio me jata hai — table ki jagah Room No. search hota hai.

subsections.title: 3.2c POS Bill Reprint (Restaurant)
subsections.navPath: Point Of Sale ▶ Restaurant ▶ POS Bill Reprint
subsections.paragraph: Purane POS bills dobara print karo — Year + Bill No. se search karke reprint.

subsections.title: 3.3 Outlet Variations (Bar / Room Service / TADKA)
subsections.paragraph: Same screens, different outlet code. Room Service me table ki jagah Room No. hota hai aur bill direct room folio me jata hai. Bar me happy hours rates auto-apply hote hain.

subsections.title: 3.4 Outlet Setup & Table Master (Admin)
subsections.navPath: Main Setup ▶ Point of Sale ▶ Setup Outlet / Table Master
subsections.paragraph: Outlet Setup me outlet bante hain (name, code, type, printers). Table Master me har outlet ki tables define hoti hain (table no., capacity, zone). Menu Item screen se items aur rates manage hote hain, POS Parameter se module behaviour.

rows: Outlet name, code, type (Rest/Bar/RS), bill printer, KOT printer
Item name, group, category, rate, tax code, bar code
Breakfast/Lunch/Dinner time slots (rate alag ho sakte hain)
Non-chargeable KOT ke reasons (complimentary, staff, wastage)

subsections.title: 4.1 Settlement Entry
subsections.navPath: Point Of Sale ▶ Restaurant ▶ Settlement Entry
subsections.paragraph: Pending bills ka payment record karo: Year + Bill No. → payment mode select → amount → narration → Submit. Pending Bill Details me Total/Paid/Balance dikhta hai.

rows: Cash in Hand / Cheque / UPI / Credit Card

subsections.title: 4.2 Table Change Entry
subsections.navPath: Point Of Sale ▶ Restaurant ▶ Table Change Entry
subsections.paragraph: Guest table badalne maange: purani table se saare KOTs naye table pe transfer karo. Bill aur items naye table ke naam ho jate hain.
steps: Purani table select karo — uske KOTs load honge
Nayi table select karo (khali honi chahiye)

subsections.title: 4.3 Table Booking
subsections.navPath: Point Of Sale ▶ Restaurant ▶ Table Booking
subsections.paragraph: Advance table booking: date/time, guest name, mobile, table, persons. Arrival pe booking se KOT shuru karo. Cancel bhi possible hai.

subsections.title: 4.4 KOT Transfer
subsections.navPath: Point Of Sale ▶ Restaurant ▶ KOT Transfer
subsections.paragraph: Galat table/outlet pe KOT ban gaya? Table-to-table ya outlet-to-outlet transfer karo. Room Service ke orders bhi restaurant me transfer ho sakte hain (vice versa).
steps: Source table/outlet se KOT select karo

subsections.title: 4.5 Display Table
subsections.navPath: Point Of Sale ▶ Restaurant ▶ Display Table
subsections.paragraph: Outlet ka live floor map — kaunsi table free, kaunsi pe KOT pending, kaunsi pe bill pending. Captain/waiter isi se tables track karte hain.

rows: Guest baithe hain, KOT chal raha hai
KOT ho gaya, bill nahi bana
Bill ho gaya, table free kar do

subsections.title: 4.6 Bill Lockup & Payment Received
subsections.navPath: Point Of Sale ▶ Restaurant ▶ Bill Lockup / Payment Received
subsections.paragraph: Bill Lockup: purane bills ki detail lookup (edit nahi hota). Payment Received: advance/partial payments record karna — guest ne pehle paisa de diya ho.

rows: Year + Bill No. se purana bill dekho — items, tax, settlement
Outlet advance cash record karo — baad me bill me adjust

subsections.title: 4.7 Service Desk
subsections.navPath: Point Of Sale ▶ Operations ▶ Service Desk
subsections.paragraph: Guest service requests (housekeeping/maintenance type) ka single window — requests accept/reject aur status track. QR-based guest portal se aayi requests bhi yahin dikhti hain.
